title: Pulse Pressure Variation in Spontaneously Breathing Patients
brief_summary: The investigators hypothesized that pulse pressure variation (PPV) could predict fluid responsiveness in spontaneously breathing patients undergoing anesthesia induction.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* patients undergoing thoracic surgery

Exclusion Criteria:

* preoperative arrhythmia
* left ventricular ejection fraction \<40%
* intra-cardiac valve disease
* intra-cardiac shunt
* pulmonary artery hypertension
* severe peripheral vascular obstructive disease
* decreased pulmonary function
